subject: proj-dy
title: PROJ.DY.------RT.ALGN.
description: Chart on book p. 341 (PMBA-5). PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the subject; RT-ALGN (reality alignment) is the partner. From the subject: TR (transformation), CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) and CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From TR: SPT-DY (spiritual dynamics) and EXP-DT (expansion dictates). From CULT-AF-BS: VT-DY (vibrational dynamics). From VT-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies). From CULT-INFO-DY: EXT-FT (extended functionalism). From EXT-FT: OBS (observation). The page text says: "To understand the vibrational dynamics of this change is to view the significance of the fifties".
